# MindeesUI

> Universal React Native CLI + Expo component library with a deterministic Layout Intelligence Layer. Components introspect their children and auto-adjust spacing, sizing, alignment, roles, and styling.

## Docs
- [Getting started](https://mindees.dev/docs)
- [Layout Intelligence Layer](https://mindees.dev/docs/architecture)
- [Compatibility matrix](https://mindees.dev/docs/compatibility)
- [Theming](https://mindees.dev/docs/theming)
